text:
Hi Anna,

Thanks for running the kickoff yesterday. On our side we consider the project formally started as of 1 September.

We agreed the scope baseline for phase 1: store inventory, point-of-sale integration and the customer profile service. Anything beyond that goes through change control.

Laura Beckett
Programme Sponsor, Meridian Retail

metadata.subject: Risk - legacy data quality for migration

text:
Mark,

Flagging a risk before it becomes a blocker. The legacy product catalogue has around 12% of records with missing category codes, and the loyalty export has duplicate customer IDs.

If this is not cleaned before the migration dry-run, we cannot guarantee a clean cutover and the go-live date is exposed.

Can you confirm who on the Meridian data team owns the cleanup, and by when? I need this to hold the schedule.

Anna

Hi Priya,

Agreed. We will treat the three acceptance criteria you listed as binding for phase 1 sign-off: end-to-end sale under 3 seconds, zero data loss on the nightly sync, and a working returns flow.

I will prepare the UAT test cases against these and share them by 25 September.

Tomasz

-----Original Message-----
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@meridian.example>
Sent: 14 September 2026 15:05
To: Tomasz Wojcik <tomasz.wojcik@northwind.example>
Subject: UAT scope and acceptance criteria

Tomasz,

Before we lock UAT, can you confirm the acceptance criteria? We need the sale transaction under 3 seconds, no data loss on the nightly sync, and returns working. Please confirm these are the ones you are building test cases for.

Priya Shah
Test Lead, Meridian Retail

metadata.subject: Change request - add loyalty module to phase 1

text:
Anna,

Our board wants the loyalty module included in phase 1 rather than phase 2. I know this is a scope change against the baseline we agreed at kickoff.

Can Northwind assess the impact on the timeline and cost, and come back with a recommendation? We would like a view before the next steering committee.

Laura

Laura,

Proposing 12 October as the phase 1 go-live, with the migration dry-run the week before. That gives us a buffer if the dry-run surfaces issues.

This assumes the data cleanup is done in time. I will confirm the date at the next steering committee.

Anna

metadata.subject: Cutover weekend plan and code freeze

text:
Laura,

Following the go-live target, here is the cutover plan for the weekend of 10-11 October. We freeze all non-critical changes from 8 October so the environment is stable going into cutover.

Decision needed from your side: can Meridian confirm the store network will be in read-only mode during the cutover window? Without that we risk data drift between the old and new systems.

Please confirm by end of week so I can brief the team.

Anna

Laura,

Short weekly update, no action needed.

Delivery is broadly on track for the 12 October go-live. Point-of-sale integration passed internal testing this week. The customer profile service is at 80% of planned scope.

One watch item: the team is running at full capacity, and the pending loyalty change request would need an extra developer to avoid slipping the date. I will bring options to the steering committee.

Anna
